_readme: TDS rates and thresholds as data (AGENTS.md rule 4). Only rows confirmed on incometaxindia.gov.in are included; anything not verified is left out rather than guessed. Under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (tax year 2026-27 onwards) TDS sits in section 393, whose tables keep the rates and thresholds of the 1961 Act (CBDT). Old section numbers are shown because most people still search by them. Table item numbers under section 393 are not recorded: check the Act.
noPanNote: If the payee has not given a valid PAN, a higher rate applies. Check the Act for the rate.
